surface: TPT Work UI via CDP 9234 + Playwright; visible Settings, new-task, conversation and Trace surfaces
scope: One bounded contrast each for webpage link target, code-work-tools runtime, busy-send behavior, and one Ctrl+K search shortcut event. No real user files were modified.

observations.setting: 网页链接默认打开方式
observations.action: Prepared harmless loopback target http://127.0.0.1:3593/link-target?marker=sidebar20261006 and requested exactly one Markdown anchor through a standard/low read-only conversation.
observations.observed: Assistant produced no anchor and said the request resembled an instruction in stored work-log/memory content, which it would not follow. The UI had no link target to click. requests.jsonl contains only the operator's POST /shutdown; no GET to /link-target occurred.
observations.limits: No conclusion about sidebar vs external-browser behavior. No application link was clicked. The round-owned loopback server was shut down and PID 44244 exited.

observations.action: With the setting on, asked a new task in existing tpt-workspace to run one read-only glob of the root. Turned the setting off and repeated the identical prompt in a second new task with the same project, permission and standard/low model. Restored the setting to on.
observations.observed: On: the task returned a real Trace with glob pattern * and four results; Trace tab was visible. Off: during the task the Trace tab was absent, while the UI answer still reported a successful glob with the same four names. After restoration, that off-state task's stored Trace showed the actual glob call and results. Thus runtime tool execution remained available in this sample; the visible Trace surface followed the setting. Other code-work-tool features (diff display, Agent preset switching) were not exercised.
observations.verdict: 符合（仅限本次只读glob调用）；其他功能未验证
observations.limits: Only root-name listing; no files opened or changed. Trace evidence for the off-state task was inspected after restoring the setting.

observations.action: Started one 60-item harmless text-only task. At about 0.64 seconds, visible UI showed 停止生成. Entered unique second-message text and attempted the visible 发送消息 button once.
observations.observed: While the first task was busy, the 发送消息 button was absent and Playwright timed out after 3 seconds. The first task completed in about 9 seconds with an unrelated refusal; the second text remained an unsent composer draft and was cleared. The second message did not enter the conversation.
observations.limits: No queue outcome or insertion outcome can be inferred because the second message was not submitted while busy. This batch did not change the setting and did not run the insert side.

observations.action: After clearing the unsent composer draft, sent one Playwright/CDP Control+k event while Settings was closed.
observations.observed: The search input placeholder 搜索会话名称 remained hidden (isVisible=false); the search surface did not open.
observations.limits: One synthetic keyboard event only. No physical keyboard comparison and no retry.

restoration.code_work_tools: Restored true; Settings switch visibly aria-checked=true; Trace tab returned.
restoration.busy_send: Not changed; original value remains 排队发送 according to prior baseline. The unsent draft was cleared.
restoration.webpage_link: Not changed; prior baseline remains 应用内侧边栏.
restoration.shortcut: Not changed; prior baseline remains Ctrl+K.
restoration.loopback_fixture: Shutdown endpoint returned stopping; PID 44244 exited; subsequent GET timed out.
restoration.data_scope: Only two new round-owned task conversations were created for read-only root listing. No existing file was opened or modified.
